production.note: First US model year: "The Hyundai Ioniq 5 N finally reaches dealerships in the U.S. this month. It arrives as a 2025 model" (March 13, 2024). Still on sale: Hyundai USA's spec page (hyundai-usa-ioniq-5-n-specs, accessed 2026-10-03) lists the 2026 IONIQ 5 N.

body.note: Hyundai USA categorises the IONIQ 5 N as an SUV (crossover).

configuration.note: "Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor"; Motor Authority (motorauthority-ioniq-5-n-price) describes a "standard dual-motor all-wheel-drive system".

transmission.note: "Single-speed reduction gear Column-mounted Shift-by-Wire (SBW)". N e-shift is a simulated eight-speed shift feel, not a gearbox.

powerHp.note: Maximum rating with N Grin Boost. Quote: "Maximum Power / (with N Grin Boost) 448 kW (601 hp) / (478 kW (641 hp))". Without N Grin Boost it is 601 hp (448 kW). The same 601/641 hp ratings applied at the 2025 launch: Autoblog (autoblog-ioniq-5-n-us-spec): "The Ioniq 5 N will produce 641 horsepower when you use the 'N Grin Boost' mode and 601 horsepower without it."

weightLb.note: US manufacturer curb weight, 2025 model year (launch year; single configuration). Quote (Hyundai Motor America, '2025 IONIQ 5 N Specifications'): "Curb Weight (lbs.) 4,861". The 2026 model page gives the same: "Curb weight (lbs.) 4861" (hyundai-usa-ioniq-5-n-specs).
